_comment: Curated high-frequency forms ABSENT from rechko (irregular paradigms it lacks). Surface -> [stress-marked readings] (U+0301; bare = unstressed clitic). Dominated by the съм 'to be' paradigm, which is irregular and missing from rechko yet extremely frequent (беше/са/бяха… ≈1.6% of corpus tokens). Phonetized by build_lexicon_phones.g2p like any other entry. Keep VERIFIED only.
